ZND-1g X-KICKER cast/cost lane, Thieving Skydiver {1}{U} with
'Kicker {X}. X can't be 0.' The printed cost carries no X, so the kicker's
{X} is the spell's ONLY X: CR 107.4a gives ONE declared value per object
(the cast's x IS the kicker's announcement, no separate kicker-X slot).
Kicked cast x=2: the CR 601.2f fold charges {1}{U}+{2}=3 generic + 1 blue,
4 U from the pool, and the journalled CAST row carries BOTH the paid-kick
flag and the declared X (kick_rows lane reads the same 6-tuple WAS_KICKED
consumes). Un-kicked second cast: {1}{U}=2, kicked=False, x=None (the X
declaration is a real choice, absent when the kick is declined). Mana math:
8 - 4 - 2 = 2. THE EFFECT LANE IS NOT EXERCISED: the gated ETB control-gain
('gain control of target artifact with mana value X or less') and 'X can't
be 0.' are UNPARSED (no X-bound atom / no gated control-gain carrier in the
frozen grammar), so the card stays engine-UNSUPPORTED and the cast settles
as a vanilla body — the honest gate holds, the effect gap is REGISTERED
(KNOWLEDGE/2026-10-18/105), never silently claimed.
